entry.name: live.map
entry.digest: Simplify the process of selecting Live interface elements for use with the Live API.
entry.description: The live.map object encapsulates the process of using the mouse to select Live user interface elements to determine their LOM paths and IDs.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: Begin the process of listening for mouse clicks for Live user interface element selection. Selecting a Live user interface element will automatically stop mapping after outputting the path and ID of the selected element.

messages.name: cancel
messages.description: Stop mapping if it was started.

messages.name: getdefault
messages.digest: Retrieve the default value of the mapped element.
messages.description: Output the default value of the mapped Live user interface element, preceded by the word, from the rightmost outlet of the object.

messages.name: getrange
messages.digest: Retrieve the range of the mapped element.
messages.description: Output the range of the mapped Live user interface element, preceded by the word, from the rightmost outlet of the object.
